Container.Name: castaway
Container.Overview: Self-hosted single-stream RTMP relay with admin dashboard and viewer-side connection diagnostics. Passes the OBS source through unchanged — viewers see exactly what you publish.
Container.Description: Castaway 0.7.6 (beta) — admin dashboard at port 7401 (everything is set there), viewer at port 8080, OBS ingest at port 1935. Low-latency HLS (1s fragments, 6s window, ~3-4s viewer start delay). HLS files live in tmpfs (RAM, 1GB cap) so SSDs don't get hammered, supports up to 4K streaming. Container runs as non-root. Mount /var/lib/castaway as a volume so settings persist.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Required. Sets the admin dashboard password. Without it the dashboard is open to anyone who can reach the port.

Config.Name: Config volume
Config.Description: Persists stream key, title, viewer password across container recreates.
